Each event opens in your calendar app for review before it is saved. TinyStock does not read your calendars.

TinyStock has no cloud of its own. A backup only leaves the device when you export the file and choose where to keep it. Android may also include the app data in your Google account backup, according to the device settings.
Order reminders are scheduled locally by Android. Notification permission and delivery are controlled in the Android settings.
